newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: FINLAND SUPPORTS CZECH EU AIMS, RESPECTS NATO GOAL.
newsitem.headline: FINLAND SUPPORTS CZECH EU AIMS, RESPECTS NATO GOAL.

text.p: Finland supports the Czech Republic's desire to join the European Union, Finnish President Martti Ahtisaari said after meeting his Czech counterpart Vaclav Havel on Monday.
Ahtisaari told reporters that his country also "respected" the Czechs' will to join NATO, despite the fact that Finland was not planning to do the same.
"I consider the Czech Republic to be a very good candidate for the European Union entry, and Finland supports your your interest in memebership in this organisation," he said.
After the presidents' meeting, Havel quoted Ahtisaari as saying that Finland "respects every country's right to aim for a solution it desires."
Havel noted that talks with Ahtasaari also touched the positions and future perspectives of the Baltic states.
The Czech Republic has set EU and NATO memebreship as its primary foreign policy aims after the end of the communist rule in 1989.

The Finnish president is scheduled to meet reporesentatives of Czech political parties and the chairman of the Chamber of Deputies, opposition Social democratic leader Milos Zeman before he concludes his official visit on Wednesday.
